description:
Combat Background Enhanced

Download

Code repo

Combat Background Enhanced focuses on adding visual flare by procedurally generating asteroid fields and hulk fleets in the background of fleet combat.Can be added/removed from existing saves.

Features

Layered background rendering system that simulates depth in the visuals and fades out from the main combat actionHulk fleets based on nearby factions in the region.Automatically supports modded factions and custom ships they use.Asteroid fields.Procedural generation so each background is unique.Support for modular part ships and stations with broken off pieces.

Combat Background Enhanced will have an extra performance cost on combat rendering. If you are having issues with this, I added a settings file that you can use to toggle on/off some of the larger performance contributors as you need.

descriptionHtml:
Combat Background Enhanced

Download



Code repo
Combat Background Enhanced focuses on adding visual flare by procedurally generating asteroid fields and hulk fleets in the background of fleet combat.Can be added/removed from existing saves.
Features
  • Layered background rendering system that simulates depth in the visuals and fades out from the main combat action
  • Hulk fleets based on nearby factions in the region.
  • Automatically supports modded factions and custom ships they use.
  • Asteroid fields.
  • Procedural generation so each background is unique.
  • Support for modular part ships and stations with broken off pieces.

Combat Background Enhanced will have an extra performance cost on combat rendering. If you are having issues with this, I added a settings file that you can use to toggle on/off some of the larger performance contributors as you need.
